{{unknown name}} [[File:Tao trio Adventures.png|thumb|right|250px|Reshiram, Kyurem, and Zekrom in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] '''Reshiram''' (Japanese: '''レシラム''' ''Reshiram''), '''Zekrom''' (Japanese: '''ゼクロム''' ''Zekrom''), and '''Kyurem''' (Japanese: '''キュレム''' ''Kyurem'') are recurring {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Reshiram== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Dragon |type2=Fire |ball=None |trainername=Black |pokemonname=Reshiram |jtrainername=ブラック |jpokemonname=レシラム |tmtrainername=Black |tmpokemonname=Reshiram |image=[[File:Black Reshiram Adventures.png|180px]] |caption=Black's Reshiram |caught=yes |location={{un|Pokémon League}} |gender=Gender unknown{{p|Reshiram}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species. |ability={{a|Turboblaze}} |epnum=PS475 |epname=The Mystery of the Missing Fossil |released=yes |releaseep=PS547 |releasename=The Final Battle |prevonum=643 |noevo=incap |current=[[Unova]] |media=special |va=no }} '''Black's Reshiram''' (Japanese: '''ブラックのレシラム''' ''Black's Reshiram'') is the light Dragon and [[Unova]]'s "truth" who was owned by {{adv|Black}} and his sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. ===History=== [[File:Light Stone Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|As the [[Light Stone]]]] ====Background==== Thousans of years prior to the events of the manga, {{p|Reshiram}} was part of a single powerful Dragon {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} used by [[Heroes of Truth and Ideals|twin heroes]] who created the [[Unova]] region. The two brothers argued over how to rule the Unova region. The elder brother pursued the truth while the younger brother pursued ideals. Unable to choose a side, the Dragon Pokémon split into two beings: Reshiram, who sided with the elder brother, and {{p|Zekrom}}, who sided with the younger. Sometime after the two brothers battled, Reshiram and Zekrom transformed into the [[Light Stone|Light]] and [[Dark Stone]]s, respectively. ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== [[File:Black and Reshiram.png|thumb|left|180px|Reshiram and {{adv|Black}}]] In the [[PS474|present day]], both stones were found at the [[Desert Resort]] by [[Clay]] and his mining crew. Feeling a strange surge of power every time he touched the stones, Clay became concerned and asked [[Lenora]] to study them. The Light and Dark Stones were taken to [[Nacrene Museum]] to be studied, but only the Dark Stone's discovery was made public knowledge. Lenora later discovered the both stones were actually the [[Legendary Pokémon]] Reshiram and Zekrom. As Lenora studied the stones, [[Team Plasma]] spied on her with the intent on stealing the stones. In ''[[PS495|The Battle Within]]'', the [[Shadow Triad]] launched the operation to retrieve the Dark Stone. The Unova [[Gym Leader]]s each fought against the Shadow Triad to protect the Dark Stone. Eventually, the [[Gym]] Leaders won, but were defeated when the Shadow Triad revealed their trump card, the {{adv|forces of nature}}. Though the Gym Leaders were defeated and captured, the Shadow Triad were unable to break into the basement where the Dark Stone was kept. By disguising himself as [[Brycen]], a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} tricked {{adv|Black}} into leading him into the basement, allowing [[Ghetsis]] to take the Dark Stone and knock Black unconscious. After Ghetsis had left, the real Brycen entered the basement and found the unconscious Black. He opened the lock to the Light Stone, which rolled towards Black, choosing him to be the next Hero of Truth. Brycen then decided to take Black and train him so that he may be able to wield Reshiram's power against Team Plasma. In ''[[PS509|Will the Truth Come Out?]]'', Black stumbles across a battle between {{adv|N}} and [[Alder]]. When he notices that N managed to get Zekrom to join him, the Light Stone glows brightly and Reshiram briefly emerges from it before retreating back inside. [[File:Black vs N Adventures.png|thumb|right|250px|Black and Reshiram vs {{adv|N}} and Zekrom]] In ''[[PS518|True Friends]]'', Black, enraged that Team Plasma managed to manipulate his friend {{adv|Cheren}}, angrily demands Team Plasma to reveal themselves. This causes Reshiram to fully emerge from the Light Stone. After Team Plasma surrounds the {{un|Pokémon League}} with [[N's Castle]], Reshiram senses Zekrom's presence and goes off to fight its counterpart alone. After catching up with it, Black rides on Reshiram's back as they face off against N and Zekrom in their final battle. Though initially fearful that he may not be able to live up to the previous Hero's legacy, Black musters up the courage to fight alongside Reshiram. Together, Black and Reshiram hit Zekrom with a powerful {{m|Fusion Flare}}, knocking Zekrom and N to the ground. Zekrom quickly gets back up and flies to N's Castle with Black and Reshiram following after it. Upon arriving, Black is shocked to see a [[N's Zorua|second]] Zekrom fighting alongside the original one. Though momentarily confused, Black sees through the ruse and has Reshiram attack the real Zekrom, defeating it. The battle left Reshiram exhausted, leaving it unable to help Black in his final battle against Ghetsis. After N and Zekrom leave, Reshiram lets out a roar as it begins reverting back into the Light Stone. Black realizes that if he and {{adv|White}} stand near it, they will be absorbed into the Light Stone as well. Hearing this, Ghetsis uses [[Colress]]'s {{p|Beheeyem}} to throw Black onto Reshiram before making his escape. Black is unable to escape and is sealed into the Light Stone alongside Reshiram. When White attempts to grab the Light Stone, it flies off to parts unknown. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== [[File:White Kyurem Adventures.png|thumb|180px|Reshiram [[Pokémon fusion|absofused]] with Kyurem]] In ''[[PS540|Flying Ship]]'', N and Zekrom were seen chasing after the Light Stone. The Light Stone [[PS541|eventually]] landed in the [[Entralink]] and was found by White. Zekrom arrived soon after and took the group towards Kyurem, being drawn in by its power. After [[PS542|reaching]] Kyurem, N had White take the Light Stone to safety as he believed that if Zekrom were defeated and absorbed by Kyurem, the Light Stone would react and turn back into Reshiram. In ''[[PS544|Dream World]]'', White and N were taken into the Light and Dark Stones, respectively, after Kyurem reverted Zekrom. They arrived at the [[Pokémon Dream World]], where they met with Black again. Black revealed he wanted the Light Stone to be absorbed so he and Reshiram could fight Kyurem from the inside, but decided to have N do it instead while he and White headed outside to fight Kyurem directly. However, when Reshiram tried to attack Kyurem, it was blasted back by a powerful {{m|Fusion Bolt}}. Soon after, Reshiram was seen interacting with the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', Reshiram leaves with the Unova [[Pokédex holder]]s and the Swords of Justice to pursue Kyurem, following the Boundary Pokémon to the [[Giant Chasm]]. [[PS546|Once]] they arrived at the Giant Chasm, Colress has Kyurem attack Reshiram and the Unova Pokédex holders. Using the Giant Chasm to boost Kyurem's [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Reshiram, Zekrom, and Kyurem|Overdrive mode]], Colress commands Kyurem to freeze the entire chasm, as it can't directly freeze Reshiram. Before Kyurem finishes the attack, it stops on its own, as it had been freed from the control of the [[Colress Machine]]. Kyurem reverts to its normal form and absorbs Reshiram to become {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}. In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', Kyurem separated itself from Reshiram again before leaving. Reshiram then flew Black, White, and [[Iris]] to the [[Plasma Frigate]], where it helped those on board escape before it crashed. After Ghetsis was captured, Reshiram left Black. ===Personality and characteristics=== Reshiram is a powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, easily competing with other [[Legendary Pokémon]]. {{adv|Black}} was quickly overwhelmed by Reshiram's power, feeling as though his mind and body were being crushed by its presence. Reshiram has a close relationship with its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, choosing Black as its Hero of Truth. Black was also able to quickly connect his heart to Reshiram during their battle against {{adv|N}} and {{p|Zekrom}}. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|Dragon|Fire|Black Reshiram {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Fusion Flare|1=Dragon Pulse|2=Blue Flare}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Fusion Flare|1=Dragon Pulse|2=Blue Flare}}}} {{anmov|Fire|Fusion Flare|PS521|Triple Threat}} {{anmov|Dragon|Dragon Pulse|PS522|Homecoming}} {{anmov|Fire|Blue Flare|PS545|Deduction Time}} {{anmov/f|Fire}} ===Trivia=== * Reshiram is Black's only Pokémon that: ** Does not have a [[nickname]]. ** Has never had its [[level]] revealed. ** Does not have an [[List of Pokémon by evolutionary line|evolutionary line]]. ** Is [[gender unknown]]. ==Zekrom== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Dragon |type2=Electric |ball=None |trainername=N |pokemonname=Zekrom |jtrainername=Ｎ |jpokemonname=ゼクロム |tmtrainername=N |tmpokemonname=Zekrom |image=[[File:N Zekrom Adventures.png|180px]] |caption=N's Zekrom |caught=yes |location=[[Dragonspiral Tower]] |gender=Gender unknown{{p|Zekrom}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species. |ability={{a|Teravolt}} |nature=Naughty |epnum=PS474 |epname=Defeating Stoutland |released=yes |releaseep=PS547 |releasename=The Final Battle |prevonum=644 |noevo=incap |current=[[Unova]] |media=special |va=no }} '''N's Zekrom''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|Ｎ|エヌ}}のゼクロム''' ''N's Zekrom'') is the dark Dragon and [[Unova]]'s "ideals" who joined {{adv|N}} in his goal to liberate all {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. It is at [[level]] 50 and its [[Characteristic]] is that it is "often lost in thought." ===[[Pokémon Adventures]]=== [[File:Dark Stone Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|As the [[Dark Stone]]]] ====History==== =====Background===== Thousans of years ago, {{p|Zekrom}} was part of a single powerful Dragon {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} used by twin heroes who created the [[Unova]] region. The two brothers argued over how to rule the Unova region. The younger brother pursued ideals while the elder brother pursued the truth. Unable to choose a side, the Dragon Pokémon split into two beings: Zekrom, who sided with the younger brother, and {{p|Reshiram}}, who sided with the elder. Sometime after the two brothers battled, Zekrom and Reshiram transformed into the [[Light Stone|Light]] and [[Dark Stone]]s, respectively. ====={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===== [[File:N and Zekrom.png|thumb|left|180px|Zekrom and {{adv|N}}]] In the [[PS474|present day]], both stones were found at the [[Desert Resort]] by [[Clay]] and his mining crew. Feeling a strange surge of power every time he touched the stones, Clay became concerned and asked [[Lenora]] to study them. The Dark and Light Stones were taken to [[Nacrene Museum]] to be studied, but only the Dark Stone's discovery was made public knowledge. Lenora later discovered that both stones were actually the [[Legendary Pokémon]] Reshiram and Zekrom. As Lenora studied the stones, [[Team Plasma]] spied on her with the intent of stealing the stones. In ''[[PS495|The Battle Within]]'', the [[Shadow Triad]] launched the operation to retrieve the Dark Stone. The Unova [[Gym Leader]]s each fought against the Shadow Triad to protect the Dark Stone. Eventually, the [[Gym]] Leaders won but were defeated when the Shadow Triad revealed their trump card, the {{adv|forces of nature}}. Though the Gym Leaders were defeated and captured, the Shadow Triad was unable to break into the basement where the Dark Stone was kept. By disguising himself as [[Brycen]], a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} tricked {{adv|Black}} into leading him into the basement, allowing [[Ghetsis]] to take the Dark Stone and knock Black unconscious. Ghetsis took the stone to [[Dragonspiral Tower]], where he presented it to {{adv|N}}, who awakened Zekrom. Though initially wary of N, Zekrom eventually decided to join N's side, choosing him to be the next Hero of Ideals. In ''[[PS508|The Lesson Ends Here]]'', N is approached by [[Alder]], who recounts the legend of Unova's founding before challenging N to a battle. When Black arrives to see the battle, he notices that N managed to awaken Zekrom. The Light Stone glows brightly and Reshiram briefly emerges from it before retreating back inside. Though N is not surprised that Black possesses the Light Stone, he questions why Reshiram chose him. After the battle ends and N leaves, he hears Zekrom's voice, revealing that it wishes to fight against Black once he has fully become the Hero of Truth. [[File:Black vs N Adventures.png|thumb|250px|N and Zekrom vs {{adv|Black}} and Reshiram]] In ''[[PS518|True Friends]]'', Black, enraged that Team Plasma managed to manipulate his friend {{adv|Cheren}}, angrily demands Team Plasma to reveal themselves, causing Reshiram to fully emerge from the Light Stone. Team Plasma soon attacks the {{un|Pokémon League}}, surrounding it with [[N's Castle]]. With both Dragons fully awakened, N and Black have their final battle in the skies above N's Castle. Though N initially has the advantage in the battle, Black exploits the connection between Zekrom and Reshiram to deal a powerful blow to Zekrom with {{m|Fusion Flare}}, knocking Zekrom and N to the ground. Zekrom quickly gets back up and flies to N's Castle with Black and Reshiram following after it. Upon arriving, Black is shocked to see another Zekrom fighting alongside the original one. Though momentarily confused, Black sees through the ruse and has Reshiram attack the real Zekrom, defeating it. The fake Zekrom soon reveals itself to be N's {{TP|N|Zorua}}, who wished to fight alongside N despite being {{pkmn2|released}} earlier. N scolds Zorua shortly before the two of them pass, leaving them unable to witness Black's final battle against Ghetsis. After Ghetsis is defeated, N wakes up. N, having his worldview changed, decides to leave Unova to follow his own path. Leaving Zorua behind, N and Zekrom fly off to parts unknown. ======{{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}====== [[File:Black Kyurem Adventures.png|thumb|180px|Zekrom [[Pokémon fusion|absofused]] with Kyurem]] In ''[[PS540|Flying Ship]]'', Zekrom and N returned to Unova. They stopped at the [[Entralink]], where N reunited with {{adv|White}} after she obtained the Light Stone. After explaining the situation, N and Zekrom took White to the [[Plasma Frigate]], where they confronted Ghetsis and Kyurem. N revealed that if Zekrom were to be absorbed, then the Light Stone would react to Kyurem's power and revert back into Reshiram. In ''[[PS543|Abyssal Ruins]]'', Ghetsis obtained the [[DNA Splicers]], which allowed Kyurem to revert Zekrom back into the Dark Stone, sealing N inside with it. Afterward, N arrived at the [[Pokémon Dream World]], where he reunited with Black. After White was taken into the Light Stone, Black decided to have N and Zekrom fight Kyurem from the inside while he, White, and Reshiram exited the Light Stone to fight Kyurem directly. However, N had been forced out of the Dream World by the [[PS544|next chapter]]. In ''[[PS546|Giant Chasm]]'', Kyurem was freed from the control of the [[Colress Machine]] and ejects the Dark Stone from its body so it can absorb Reshiram instead. In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', Zekrom emerged from the Dark Stone and saved Ghetsis from his fall off of the Plasma Frigate and handed him to the [[International Police]]. Soon after, Zekrom left N. =====Personality and characteristics===== Zekrom is a powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, easily competing with other [[Legendary Pokémon]]. {{adv|Black}} was quickly overwhelmed by Zekrom's power, feeling as though his mind and body were being crushed by its presence. Zekrom has a close relationship with {{adv|N}}, choosing N to be his Hero of Ideals. N was also able to quickly connect with Zekrom because of his ideals. =====Moves used===== {{anmov/h|Dragon|Electric|N Zekrom Fusion Bolt Adventures.png|Using Fusion Bolt}} {{anmov|Electric|Fusion Bolt|PS521|Triple Threat}} {{anmov/f|Electric}} ===In other manga=== ====[[Pocket Monsters BW: Meetings with the Legends]]==== {{p|Zekrom}} was revived in [[Dragonspiral Tower]]. After {{OBP|Touya|MWL}} had a brief discussion with [[N]] about what he was doing, N flew away on Zekrom. ====[[Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder]]==== {{p|Zekrom}} first appeared in ''[[FAT2|The King's Identity...!!]]''. Atop [[Dragonspiral Tower]] it responds to N's commitment to his ideals and allows him to befriend it. He later uses it to destroy the Pokémon League and battle against {{OBP|Shin|FAT}}. =====Moves used===== {{anmov/h|Dragon|Electric|N Zekrom {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Fusion Bolt|1=Dragon Claw}} FAT.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Fusion Bolt|1=Dragon Claw}}}} {{anmov|Electric|Fusion Bolt|FAT5|Clash! with {{color2|000|N}} |} ===In animation=== ====[[Pokémon Evolutions]]==== [[File:PE04.png|thumb|200px|Zekrom in [[Pokémon Evolutions]]]] [[File:Dark Stone Evolutions.png|thumb|left|200px|As the [[Dark Stone]] in [[Pokémon Evolutions]]]] N's Zekrom appeared in ''[[PE04|The Plan]]''. It was first seen in a series of flashbacks as N awakened it from the [[Dark Stone]] and used it to defeat [[Alder]] at the {{un|Pokémon League}}. In the present day, N prepared to use it to battle {{ga|Hilda}}. =====Moves used===== {{anmov/h|Dragon|Electric|N Zekrom Fusion Bolt Evolutions.png|Using Fusion Bolt}} {{anmov|Electric|Fusion Bolt|PE04|The Plan}} {{anmov/f|Electric}} ===In the TCG=== N's Zekrom is featured in the TCG. The following is a list of cards featuring Zekrom. {{cardlist/header|Zekrom|Dragon|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname=[[Reshiram & Zekrom-GX (Cosmic Eclipse 157)|Reshiram & Zekrom]]{{TT GX}}|type=Dragon|enset=Cosmic Eclipse|enrarity=Ultra-Rare Rare|ennum=157/236|jpset=Dream League|jprarity=RR|jpnum=036/049|enset2=Cosmic Eclipse|enrarity2=Rare Ultra|ennum2=222/236|jpset2=Dream League|jprarity2=SR|jpnum2=064/049|enset3=Cosmic Eclipse|enrarity3=Rare Secret|ennum3=259/236|jpset3=Dream League|jprarity3=HR|jpnum3=071/049}} {{cardlist/footer|Dragon}} ==Kyurem== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Dragon |type2=Ice |ball=None |trainername=Zinzolin |pokemonname=Kyurem |jtrainername=ヴィオ |jpokemonname=キュレム |tmtrainername=Vio |tmpokemonname=Kyurem |image=[[File:Zinzolin Kyurem Adventures.png|180px]] |caption=Zinzolin's Kyurem |caught=yes |location=[[Giant Chasm]] |gender=Gender unknown{{p|Kyurem}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species. |ability={{a|Pressure}} |epnum=PS536 |epname=Cold Storage Battle |released=yes |releaseep=PS547 |releasename=The Final Battle |prevonum=646 |noevo=incap |current=[[Giant Chasm]] |media=special |va=no }} '''Zinzolin's Kyurem''' (Japanese: '''ヴィオのキュレム''' ''Vio's Kyurem'') is the third Dragon {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} from the original Dragon who was owned by [[Zinzolin]]. ===[[Pokémon Adventures]]=== ====History==== [[File:Ghetsis Kyurem Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Ghetsis]] riding Kyurem]] =====Background===== Thousans of years ago, {{p|Kyurem}} was part of a single powerful Dragon {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} used by [[Heroes of Truth and Ideals|twin heroes]] who created the [[Unova]] region. When the Dragon split into {{p|Reshiram}} and {{p|Zekrom}}, a third Dragon created from what remained was born. This Dragon Pokémon, named Kyurem, belonged to neither Truth nor Ideals. Two years prior to the start of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}, Kyurem sensed the energy from the now-awakened Zekrom and, wishing for Absofusion, appeared before Zinzolin at the [[Giant Chasm]]. Kyurem was then captured by [[Zinzolin]]. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== Kyurem debuted in ''[[PS536|Cold Storage Battle]]'', where it appeared before Zinzolin and [[Colress]] at the [[Cold Storage]]. Impressed by Kyurem's strength, Colress demanded that Zinzolin handed the Boundary Pokémon over to him. Angered by Colress's arrogance, Zinzolin refused and commanded Kyurem to battle the scientist. During their battle, Colress came to the conclusion that Zinzolin's ultimate goal was to have Kyurem fuse with Reshiram or Zekrom through Absofusion. Eventually, Zinzolin was defeated by {{adv|Forces of nature|Thundurus and Landorus}} and thrown out of the building. In ''[[PS538|Therian Forme III]]'', Colress used the [[Colress Machine]] to take control of Kyurem. He used it to attack {{adv|Blake}}, but was stopped by [[Ghetsis]] when he arrived on the [[Plasma Frigate]]. Ghetsis had Colress load Kyurem onto a special room located on the ship, allowing the Plasma Frigate to fly through the air. With Kyurem's energy, the Plasma Frigate gained access to a special cannon capable of freezing buildings in an instant. In ''[[PS540|Flying Ship]]'', Blake and {{adv|Whitley}} fought to free Kyurem from [[Team Plasma]]'s control. Blake used [[Kelden]] to cut and destroy the chamber containing Kyurem, only to find it empty. Colress explained that the Plasma Frigate had drained enough energy to freeze all of Unova before commanding Kyurem to freeze Blake, Whitley, and Kelden solid. He then had the three thrown into the ocean below. [[File:Kyurem tendrils Adventures.png|thumb|right|200px|Kyurem break its wings through the [[DNA Splicers]]]] In ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', Ghetsis was given control of Kyurem so he could battle with {{adv|N}}, who had arrived to stop Team Plasma. During the battle, Ghetsis obtained the [[DNA Splicers]], which allowed Kyurem to revert Zekrom back into the [[Dark Stone]], sealing N inside with it. Kyurem then absorbed the Dark Stone to become {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|Black Kyurem}}, giving it the power to freeze [[Undella Town]] with a single {{m|Freeze Shock}}. When Reshiram attempted to fight Kyurem, it was blasted back by a powerful {{m|Fusion Bolt}} from Kyurem. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', Kyurem began heading towards the Giant Chasm of its own free will. After they arrived, Colress retook control of Kyurem and used it to attack the Unova [[Pokédex holder]]s. When Kyurem stopped moving, [[Rood]] appeared, revealing that a machine designed to counter the Colress Machine had been activated. Kyurem reverted to its normal form and absorbed Reshiram, transforming it into {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}. Colress tried to command Kyurem once more, only for it to fire off an {{m|Ice Burn}} at him, convincing the scientist to give up and flee. Kyurem then went to destroy the Plasma Frigate, forcing {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, and [[Iris]] to try and stop it from harming the people onboard. In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', an explosion tore the Plasma Frigate apart, setting it ablaze and causing it to crash. When a piece of the ship tore off, a large pile of liberated Pokémon still inside their [[Poké Ball]]s began plummeting towards the ground. Kyurem saved the Pokémon by freezing the air to create a large bridge of ice, allowing the Poké Balls to harmlessly slide to safety. Afterward, Kyurem separated itself from Reshiram again before leaving to find Colress, where the Boundary Pokémon froze him solid with {{m|Sheer Cold}}. Once all the humans had left the Giant Chasm, Kyurem covered the entire location in ice in order to rest undisturbed. =====Personality and characteristics===== Kyurem is a powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, able to keep the [[Cold Storage]] at freezing temperatures with just its presence.
